comment: What's whose: the one source for the origin labels. build.py publishes them in the ontology (i2x:Origins), build_app.py gives them to the workbench (every zone and layer carries one), build_site.py renders the reference page's table from the published ontology. 'what' and 'trust' are shared; 'definition' and 'scope', where present, replace them in the ontology when the workbench wording speaks of 'this page'. {nTypes}, {nFields}, {nCurated} and {nSources} are counted from the pinned release; 'where' is the workbench's wording, with {release}, {commit7}, {base} and {foxxi} filled in at build time; 'heldIn' names the graphs, services and manifests where statements of that origin live ({ontology}, {catalog}, ... are I2IDL-X graph IRIs, {foxxiManifest} the Foxxi bridge manifest).

scheme.label: What's whose
scheme.definition: Where a statement shown alongside the I2IDL glossary comes from: I2IDL's own published record, one of the three kinds of I2IDL-X layer (derived, added, proposed), Interego, Foxxi, or a reviewing team. I2IDL's record is never restated or edited; everything else carries its own label.

groups.label: I2IDL-X
groups.definition: Everything this superset puts on top of I2IDL, in three kinds kept apart: derived from I2IDL's own data, added links, and proposals awaiting review.

origins.label: I2IDL
origins.what: Labels and alternate labels, definitions, editorial notes, editorial status, the {nTypes} types, {nFields} fields and {nCurated} curated collections, broader / narrower / related links, evidence records and their direct / supporting classification, the {nSources} sources and their rights, the release itself.
origins.where: id.i2idl.org — I2IDL's JSON-LD graph, SPARQL service and concept pages. This page embeds {release} (commit {commit7}) unchanged.

origins.label: I2IDL-X · derived
origins.what: Computed from I2IDL's own data, adding no claim about meaning: definition provenance (from evidence relations), agentic kind (from type collections), reuse class (from source rights), in-text links and unlinked mentions, the eight-question view, per-term change history (from the public git history), editorial health checks, map layout, per-concept agent controls.
origins.where: Rules and graphs on Interego (i2idlx, i2idlx-rules, i2idlx-changes) and this page's build, which re-checks every derived fact against I2IDL's graph.
origins.trust: Deterministic. Recomputed from each new release.
origins.definition: Computed from I2IDL's own data, adding no claim about meaning: definition provenance (from evidence relations), agentic kind (from type collections), reuse class (from source rights), the release feed and change history (from the public git history), in-text links and unlinked mentions, editorial health checks, per-concept agent controls.

origins.label: I2IDL-X · added
origins.what: Links I2IDL-X asserts about I2IDL concepts: the specification document for a standard, a live exemplar of a concept.
origins.trust: Asserted by I2IDL-X, not by I2IDL.

origins.label: I2IDL-X · proposed
origins.what: Capability links (enactments) to live Foxxi and Interego actions, crosswalks to external vocabularies (UNESCO Thesaurus, xAPI, IEEE, schema.org, W3C VC), role capabilities, inherited enactments, and the semantic layer: what each concept classifies and how that lines up with BFO, gist, DUL, gUFO, PROV-O, schema.org and peer learning vocabularies.
origins.where: i2idlx-enactments, i2idlx-mappings, i2idlx-alignments and i2idlx-referents on Interego, published Hypothetical.
origins.trust: Hypothetical until reviewers ratify. A mapping triple exists only after ratification; a ratified crosswalk becomes a prefilled suggestion to I2IDL's editors, never an edit.

origins.label: Interego
origins.what: Where I2IDL-X lives and how agents act on it: dereferenceable graphs with signed descriptors, the HyprCat agent catalog and its controls, ratification algebra (for = Asserted, against = Counterfactual, abstain = Hypothetical), publish and act calls.
origins.trust: Signed by the publishing agent; content-hashed.

origins.label: Foxxi
origins.what: The live learning capabilities enactments point to (Foxxi bridge affordances), xAPI usage statements tagged with I2IDL IRIs, course-concept alignment and coverage.

origins.label: Your team
origins.what: Votes, notes and “I use this” marks (shared on this page); packs, stars and recent terms (private to you).
origins.trust: Visible to everyone with access to this page.
origins.definition: Reviewers' votes, notes and usage marks. In the workbench they are shared with everyone who can open it; made through Interego, a vote is an i2x:RatificationVote in the reviewer's own pod.
origins.scope: Each reviewer's own record; a ratified outcome is computed from the votes, never typed in.
